senses.gloss:
m. (-पः)
1 The family priest.
2 Water.
E.
णी to guide, Uṇādi aff. प.

n. (-थ्यं)
1 A stage, or the part behind the scenes, the tiring room, &c.
2 Ornament, embellishment.
E.
णी to guide, विच् aff. and the vowel changed; ने the eye, or a chief, पथ्य proper, agreeable, grateful.

n. (-लः)
The country of Nepal.
E.
ने a chief: see the last, and पाल cherishing.

f. (-का)
Arsenic.
E.
नेपाल, and कन् aff.
